name: remoteconnect-mcp
description: Inspect and edit disposable RemoteConnect project copies on Windows.
long_description: Local offline tools for SCADAPack x70 project inspection and editing. Includes the Python runtime and dependencies. Requires separately installed, licensed Schneider software. The 42-tool offline profile excludes equipment operations. Keep engineering originals outside the disposable workspace.

workspace.title: Disposable project workspace
workspace.description: Optional folder for project copies. Leave blank to use %LOCALAPPDATA%\RemoteConnectMCP\workspace. Keep engineering originals elsewhere.

xpdf_context.title: Installed SCADAPack XPDF context
xpdf_context.description: Optional SCBForSCADAPack.xpdf file from the licensed Schneider installation. Leave blank for automatic discovery.
